# hyperfine

A command-line benchmarking tool.

## Install

```sh
ocx pull sharkdp/hyperfine@latest
ocx run sharkdp/hyperfine -- --help
```

## Highlights

- Ships as a single static binary.
- Pinned by digest, never by moving tag.
- Reads configuration from the environment.

| Platform | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| linux/amd64 | yes |
| darwin/arm64 | yes |

See the [project page](https://example.com/sharkdp/hyperfine) for details.
